summary: Frontend E2E for 4 new Truck Cleaning features (Booking QR share, Top-5 Yard Blast, Contract E-Sign, Print-Ready Business Card) + /wash regression. ALL PASS. Booking QR image loads (490x490 PNG), copy link works (toast fires; 'Copy failed' surface expected in headless with no clipboard permission — copy path still executes), Download QR link present. Yard Blast: 5 email inputs (YP-01..YP-05), BLAST button disabled with no emails, enabled after 1 email entered, click BLAST → YP-01 stage moved from 'prospect' → 'pitched' (verified via API). Contract flow on YP-02: inline panel opens with frequency select + cabs input + CREATE button; click created agreement with sign_url in success toast: 'Sign link copied — text it to the yard manager · https://.../tc/sign/e390af17...'. Public /tc/sign/{token} on 480px viewport: summary shows QA Sign Yard / Bi-Weekly / 5 cabs / $130 rate / $1,411 monthly; terms + form render; empty-name submit produces error toast 'Type your full legal name to sign'; filling name + title + agree → success card 'Locked in! Signed — welcome aboard, QA Sign Yard!'. Branded Docs tab: business-card and one-pager buttons present and backend PDFs return 200 (289KB and 2.3MB, valid %PDF-1.4). /wash regression: fill company + phone + submit → wash-booking-success card 'Request received!' renders. Cleaned up all test artifacts (agreements, clients, recurring, booking, YP-02 pending agreement, reset YP-01 & YP-02 stage/email).
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 new features wired end-to-end and verified in browser. Testids consistent with spec.
Public sign page correctly reads token from URL, renders agreement summary, enforces name + agree validation, posts to /public/agreement/{token}/sign, and shows success state.
Yard Blast PATCHes stage only when current stage is 'prospect' (guards against overwriting pitched/meeting/etc.) — good defensive behavior confirmed.

Copy-to-clipboard failure in preview browser is a headless limitation, not a code bug — navigator.clipboard.writeText requires focus/permission. Consider adding a fallback (execCommand or manual textarea select) for older/restricted browsers; low priority.
Business Card & One-Pager buttons are BUTTON elements (likely calling api.get with blob); PDFs verified to return 200/application-pdf via direct curl.
